campus.name: StuHelper Campus
campus.lead: A course community for university members. Read reviews of courses and teachers, find past papers and notes, and compare the courses you are considering.

reviews.title: Course and teacher reviews
reviews.text: Reviews come from students with an enrolment record and cover five dimensions. Graduate supervisors have their own reviews.

resources.title: Study resources
resources.text: Past papers, notes and slides are filed by course, and students can upload and share their own.

compare.title: Course comparison
compare.text: Put several candidate courses side by side and compare ratings, credits and teachers.

schedule.title: My timetable
schedule.text: See your courses by term, with their teachers, times and places.

api.lead: A relay service for large language model APIs. Models from different vendors sit behind one address, so switching models only means changing the model name in your client.

protocols.title: Three protocols
protocols.text: Compatible with the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini interfaces. Existing SDKs only need a different request address.

tokens.title: Tokens under control
tokens.text: Each token can have its own quota and list of allowed models, and can be disabled at any time.

usage.title: Clear usage
usage.text: Every request records its model, token count and cost. Billing follows actual usage.

models.title: Model catalogue
models.text: See the available models, their vendors and how each is billed in one place.

playground.title: Playground
playground.text: Talk to a model directly in the browser and check the result before integrating.

wallet.title: Wallet and plans
wallet.text: Supports balance top-ups, redemption codes and subscription plans.

store.lead: Start a ChatGPT subscription or add Codex credits on your own account. You pay in Chinese yuan, and every processing stage after payment appears on the order page.

gpt.title: Official GPT top-up
gpt.text: Start or upgrade a ChatGPT subscription on your own account, covering the Go, Plus and Pro plans.

codex.title: Codex credits
codex.text: Top up by credits. The unit price and total for the chosen region are shown before you order.

check.title: Account check before ordering
check.text: The account type, current subscription and billing region are confirmed live, and only plans that account can buy are shown.

upgrade.title: Upgrade credit
upgrade.text: When an account with a web subscription upgrades, the remaining subscription time is deducted from the price.

progress.title: Visible progress
progress.text: The order page shows the stage the top-up task has reached. An unclear result is checked further, and each order is charged once.

receipts.title: Receipts and renewal status
receipts.text: After completion you can download the invoice and receipt, and see whether auto-renewal has been turned off.

platform.title: SSO and open platform
platform.lead: Every StuHelper service is built on one identity system. Single sign-on provides authentication over the standard OIDC protocol. The open platform lets third-party developers connect their own apps and, once the user consents, read business data such as student verification status and timetables.

identity.title: Single sign-on
identity.text: Registration, sign-in and password recovery are handled by a separate sign-on service. Each app confirms identity through OIDC and keeps its own session.

apps.title: Third-party apps
apps.text: Developers submit their app details, purpose and requested data scopes, and connect after review. The authorization flow requires PKCE.

scopes.title: Data opened by scope
scopes.text: Student verification status, school, profile, timetable, course catalogue and public reviews are each requested and approved separately.

consent.title: Item-by-item consent
consent.text: Signing in to an app and sharing data are separate steps. Users agree to each item and can withdraw it in their personal center at any time.

complaint.description: If details are wrong or infringe someone’s rights, choose a category and explain. The school may hide the homepage details; the catalog entry and reviews stay.
complaint.sent: Your report was sent. The school will review it soon.

request.title: New request
request.label: Item name
request.labelHint: Enter the name of the item or the section title to correct or add.
request.labelOptional: Leave empty to hide the whole group.
request.supervisorsHint: The ticked roles replace the current list; ticking none clears it.
request.photoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MiB.
request.photoType: Only JPEG or PNG images are accepted.
request.photoSize: The image must be 2 MiB or smaller.
request.photoReadError: Could not read the selected photo. Try again or select the file again.
request.sent: Your request was sent. You will be notified after the school reviews it.
request.retention: The request text and photo are deleted 12 months after the request is closed.

media.loadFailed: The homepage’s images, videos and attachments couldn’t be loaded.

media.imageLink: View the image on the school page
media.videoLink: Watch the video on the school page
media.attachmentLink: Open the attachment on the school page
media.external: (opens the school website in a new window)

privacy.title: Privacy and consents
privacy.description: See the agreements you accepted and manage consents you can withdraw separately.
privacy.withdrawAgreements: If you no longer agree to the Terms of Service or the Privacy Policy, you can close your account.
